idea-plugin.name: Pi Terminal Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Pi Terminal Bridge

Persistent Pi coding agent sessions for JetBrains IDEs — launch, track and resume conversations, with a live bridge between the IDE and the pi terminal. Integrated terminal with the full pi TUI, send code context, model selection, optional auto-open of files modified by Pi.

Important: Install the Pi CLI separately before using this plugin.
npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent or visit pi.dev

Features

  • Persistent conversations — sessions survive IDE restarts; click to relaunch and resume
  • Live bridge — working/idle badges, current model, and session switches (/new, /fork) reflected in the IDE panel in real time; old sessions archived and resumable
  • One-click launch from the toolbar in a dedicated Terminal tab
  • Send to Pi — select code, right-click, and send file reference (@path/file.go#L10-25) to Pi's input
  • Notifications — optional balloon when the agent finishes; optionally open files Pi edited
  • Flexible configuration for models, thinking levels, and launch options

Usage

Quick Start

  1. Click the pi button in the main toolbar.
  2. A new Pi tab opens in the Terminal window and runs pi automatically.
  3. Select code, right-click, then Send to Pi to add file context to your prompt.
  4. Close and reopen the IDE — conversations are listed in the Pi panel and resume on click.

Configuration

Open Settings, Tools, Pi Terminal Bridge to pick the model, thinking level, launch options, and bridge features.

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Ctrl+Shift+` — Open the Pi conversation window
  • Ctrl+Shift+L — Send selection / file to Pi

Supported IDEs

Works with all JetBrains IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, and more.
